test_name: Awareness and Training - AT-3 Secondary Control Gap
architecture:
System: Claims-Processing-018
Primary NIST family: Awareness and Training (AT); evidence focus: AT-3.
Environment: GCP. Network access uses Private Service Connect; public ingress to managed data services is blocked. Transport uses TLS 1.3 and strict mTLS for service-to-service paths. Privileged administrators use hardware-backed MFA. Sensitive data and secrets are encrypted at rest with a customer-managed Cloud KMS key. Control evidence: administrator role-based training has not yet been updated with lessons from the latest incident exercise. The gap is documented as a secondary control deficiency; there is no plaintext transport, no public database exposure, no unencrypted administrator credential in S3, and privileged MFA remains enabled.
